newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales up 0.2 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales up 0.2 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 0.2 percent in the week ended January 25 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 6.1 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 0.3 percent from the prior month.
"Sales were generally above plan for most retailers. Home electronics, appliances and apparel sales were all cited as strong segments of the business over the latest week," said the report.
